# Errand - Find the Ledger Keeper

## Status

Active. No progress since Session 3.

## Overview

Find whoever held the [[Nine Locks]] log book, or establish that the post is empty.

## Objectives

- [ ] Establish whether [[The Ledger Keeper]] is a person or a post
- [ ] Recover the log book

## Quest Giver

[[Marisol Quay]], who asked for it as a favour rather than as work.

## What We Know

One page survives, and [[Wren Ashgrove]] has it. The page names [[The Fifth Keeper]],
who has no note yet.

## Dangers

Unknown, which is not the same as none.

## Notes

Nobody the crew has asked will say whether the post is still filled.
